stories.title: Updates by themselves
stories.text: ihatecrypto looks for a new version once a day. When one is ready you get a notification; Install shows what changed first.

stories.title: A sound for each thing
stories.text: A coin rings when money arrives or a move finishes, a soft chime when something wants a look, a low knock when a move fails.

stories.title: Tickers, not addresses
stories.text: A token's contract shows as its ticker: AERO (0x9401…8631). A ticker that imitates another, like USDC on the wrong contract, gets ⚠.

stories.title: / and @ in the chat
stories.text: Type / for the blocks you can add, with an example to finish. Type @ for names from your address book and favorite tokens.
